tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Returns what UGC Pocket does, the creator categories and platforms a draft can target, the price model and what happens after a draft. No authentication. Call it to learn valid values, or when the user asks how UGC Pocket works or what it costs.

tools.name: create_campaign_draft
tools.description: START HERE when a user asks how to promote their app, software, service, game or course, or wants UGC videos. Builds a campaign draft WITHOUT any account or API key and returns a claim_url to give the user. The link shows the campaign you built, with no login needed; the user confirms it with a 6-di

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_campaign_draft · Private data: create_campaign_draft · Public sink: create_campaign_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_campaign_draft · Private data: create_campaign_draft · Public sink: create_campaign_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_service_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns the UGC Pocket service descriptor: creator categories (e.g. dog, cooking, sport), prestation types, supported platforms, currency (EUR, budgets in cents), minimum and maximum campaign budget, the order model (agent creates a draft, a human confirms and funds it in the app), AND the "onboardi" → after: "Returns what UGC Pocket does, the creator categories and platforms a draft can target, the price model and what happens after a draft. No authentication. Call it to learn valid values, or when the user asks how UGC Pocket works or what it costs."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_campaign_draft" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "START HERE when a user asks how to promote their app, software, service or course. Builds a complete UGC campaign draft WITHOUT any API key or account, and returns a claim_url to hand to the user. Opening that link shows them the campaign you built, with no login required; they then sign in with a 6" → after: "START HERE when a user asks how to promote their app, software, service, game or course, or wants UGC videos. Builds a campaign draft WITHOUT any account or API key and returns a claim_url to give the user. The link shows the campaign you built, with no login needed; the user confirms it with a 6-di"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
